title: evidence
description: One captured source document, backed by a content-addressed snapshot (PRD §7, R1.4). Snapshot or drop: no evidence without content_hash.

id.description: Deterministic: 'ev_' + first 24 hex of sha256(source, url, content_hash).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes, lowercase hex.

snapshot_ref.description: Where the raw bytes live in private storage (s3://bucket/sha256/.. or local:sha256/..).

reliability.description: high = primary raw API/archive data; medium = rendered page or secondary aggregator; low = unverified third-party claim.

retention_class.description: person_level_24m: contains person-level data, raw kept 24 months (PRD §10); project_level: no time limit; derived_aggregate: no person-level data.

deletion_state.description: present; deleted_upstream (removed at source, raw pending drop); raw_dropped (raw removed, hash + coded facts kept, R1.5).
